description: Use when the user wants to change what an AI employee team works from (teamId from list_teams). patch is merged into the brief (null removes a field) and stored as its next version; the answer says which member picks it up and when. apply: "wake_now" also starts the members that are idle, within the team's usual limits. baseVersion, the version you read with get_team_status, refuses a change made over someone else's. The company name, markets and channels cannot be removed. Only the person who launched the team or a workspace admin can. Confirm the change with the user first. No cost to call.

baseVersion.description: The brief version you read, to refuse a stale change.

patch.description: Brief fields to change (JSON merge patch); null removes one.

name: update_team_brief

outputSchema.description: The stored brief version and which member picks it up when.

title: Update Team Brief
